description: Labeled queries for router accuracy evaluation. Tier 1 (self-labelable). NOTE: 'mode' field uses synthesizer mode names (rag_only, guided_step, out_of_scope) not router intent names (rag_query, start_guided) — the chat endpoint metadata exposes synthesizer mode, not raw router intent. NOTE: R16 should be excluded from accuracy calculation if it times out (90s) — the timeout is a network/API issue not a classification failure.
